fields.notes: MIPI D-PHY / CSI-2 specs do NOT define standard scan or JTAG. Debug relies on in-band integrity: Sync pattern lock, ECC syndrome, CRC-16. Production characterization uses eye diagrams + PHY conformance tests (MIPI Alliance test suite). Vendor PHY IP commonly adds optional BIST modes, loopback paths, and eye-monitor circuitry — these are per-implementation.
internal_diagnostics: In-band error reporting via ECC (1-bit correct / 2-bit detect) and CRC-16 (payload mismatch).
Sync-pattern miss-lock detector reports loss of receiver alignment.
Lane-skew calibration during HS Entry trains per-lane delay-lines.
FS / FE / LS / LE short-packet counters validate frame completeness.

scan_topology.vendor_BIST_extensions: Some commercial CSI-2 RX IP cores (e.g. Synopsys, Cadence) add MIPI CSI-2 BIST and PHY loopback test modes, but these are NOT part of the MIPI D-PHY / CSI-2 specs.

extraction_hints: Look for scan / DFT / BIST / JTAG sections.
